About China Overview

MBBS in China

China, or the People’s Republic of China, is the world’s most populous country with over 1.4 billion people. Located in East Asia, it is renowned for its ancient civilization, rich cultural heritage, and rapid modernization. It boasts a strong economy, advanced technology, and top-class infrastructure and is a world leader in most fields, including medicine and education.

China is home to some of the top medical colleges that offer internationally recognized degrees at affordable tuition fees, with many offering English-medium courses. Apart from education, China is famous for its Great Wall, Forbidden City, and Terracotta Warriors which showcase its rich historical past.

Its large cities, including Beijing, Shanghai, and Guangzhou, are economic hubs with modern skyscrapers, high-speed trains, and vibrant markets. With its strong healthcare system, technological advancement, and student-friendly environment, living in China as a medical student is not just enriching but also affordable.

Why Study MBBS in China?

A smart option due to its affordability and world-class education

Studying MBBS in China in 2026 is a smart option for medical aspirants. The simplified admission procedure and global career prospects make it an excellent choice for medical students worldwide.

All Requirements for MBBS in China

Understand the essential criteria and requirements

Ensure your eligibility for pursuing MBBS and starting your medical journey.

Eligibility Criteria to Apply

Students must fulfill the following requirements to apply for MBBS admission in China:

  • Age should be 17 years by 31st December in the Admission Year.
  • Must have completed 10+2 education with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology.
  • A minimum of 50% in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology is required.
  • NEET should be qualified (for Indian students).
  • Clear an Interview/Entrance Exam (Online Mode).

Required Documents & Intake

To obtain MBBS admission in China, students have to provide the necessary documents:

  • 10th Mark sheet & 12th Mark sheet & Passing Certificate
  • Passport & Aadhaar copy
  • NEET result & PCC (Police Clearance Certificate)
  • 10 White Background Photographs with 70% Face (Size 3.5 X 4.5 CM)

Intake: Admissions to Chinese medical universities are usually available twice a year - once in March and again in September.

Indian Students

Why Indian Students Choose China?

Due to high competition and expensive private medical education in India, many students now prefer MBBS in China as an affordable and reliable alternative. China provides a globally accepted medical degree, modern infrastructure, and strong clinical exposure.

MBBS in China for Indian Students

Several Chinese medical universities are approved by the NMC, allowing Indian students to return and practice in India after clearing NEXT.

Low & Transparent Fees MBBS fees in China are much lower than private colleges in India, and universities follow transparent, no-donation policies.
English-Medium Programs Many universities offer MBBS in English, making it highly convenient for Indian students to learn and adapt.
Comprehensive Clinical Training Students receive hands-on training in high-patient-flow hospitals for excellent clinical experience.
Proximity & Easy Travel Travel time from India to China is around 4.5 hours, making it easy for students to reach and for parents to visit affordably.

Advantages of Studying MBBS in China 2026

Pursuing MBBS in China in 2026 offers multiple advantages, including low fees, global recognition, modern teaching techniques, and a vibrant student life.

Advanced Medical Research Exposure

China invests heavily in medical research. Students can participate in studies related to genetics, modern healthcare advancements, and traditional medicine.

Practical-Based Learning

MBBS programs emphasize clinical practice from early years, helping students develop real-world medical skills through hospital rounds and patient interactions.

Learning Traditional Chinese Medicine

Students can explore TCM, including acupuncture and herbal medicine, which enriches their understanding of holistic healthcare.

Diverse Student Community

Thousands of students from various countries study in China, creating a multicultural environment ideal for learning and networking.

Part-Time Work and Internships

Students can take part-time jobs or internships in hospitals and research centers, helping them gain additional experience and financial support.

USMLE and NEXT Guidance

Training and guidance for exams like USMLE and NEXT are provided on campus to support students' future career goals.

Campus Life & Support

Safe & Comfortable Secure hostels with access to Indian food.

China is considered one of the safest countries for international students. University hostels are secure, well-maintained, and provide access to Indian food, making students feel at home.

Universities have dedicated international student departments that assist with accommodation, visas, language help, and cultural adjustment. Visa procedures are simple and convenient for international applicants. Studying in China exposes students to international cultures, improving global adaptability and networking.

Pathway Particulars

Duration of MBBS Course

The MBBS duration in China is 6 years, which includes 5 years of academic studies and 1 year of compulsory internship. Students are awarded the MD equivalent degree for MBBS upon successful completion.

Medium of Teaching

Many of the top medical colleges in China offer English-medium programs, making it convenient for international students from India to adapt without language barriers. Universities also provide strong support for language adjustment.

MBBS Admission In China

A step-by-step roadmap to admission

Admissions to Chinese medical universities are usually available twice a year - once in March and again in September.

  1. Fill out the application form: Fill out the application form/admission from the official portal.
  2. Select your University: Choose your NMC-approved desired university for studying MBBS in China.
  3. Submit Documents: Submit your 10th and 12th mark sheets, NEET scorecard, medical certificates, and passport copies.
  4. Receive Invitation: After applying, you’ll receive an official invitation/admission letter from the Chinese university.
  5. Apply for Visa: Apply for an X1 student visa at the respective embassy; procedures are simple and convenient for international applicants.
MBBS in China Syllabus

Comprehensive medical curriculum

Students will study the following subjects during their MBBS program in China, spanning across both theoretical and practical dimensions.

First Year

Medical Terminology, Systematic Anatomy, Computer Applied Basics, Medical Chemistry, Histology and Embryology, Cellular Biology, Regional Anatomy, Organic Chemistry.

Second Year

Physiology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Immunology, Pathophysiology, Pathology, Parasitology.

Third Year

Pharmacology, Health Statistics, Preventive Medicine, Epidemiology, Traditional Chinese Medicine, Diagnostics, Radiology, Surgery I (General), Forensic Medicine.

Fourth Year

Internal Medicine, Surgery II (Systematic), Gynecology and Obstetrics, Pediatrics, Neurology, Psychiatry, Lemoslogy, Dermatology, Stomatology, Ophthalmology, Otorhinolaryngology, Emergency Medicine.

Fifth Year

Internal Medicine, Pediatrics, Infectious Disease, Surgery, Gynecology and Obstetrics, Internship Test.

Comparing MBBS in China Vs MBBS in India

Side-by-side decision matrix

01

MBBS in India

  • Course Duration: The MBBS duration in India is 5.5 years (4.5 years academics + 1 year internship).
  • Entrance Test: Requires good 12th grade marks and qualifying NEET with strong score and cutoff.
  • Fees Structure: Government colleges: INR 11,000 to INR 7.5 lakh; Private colleges: INR 20 lakh to INR 80 lakh.
  • Degree: In India, students receive the MBBS degree after completing the course.
  • Exposure: Students have limited exposure with fewer global opportunities compared to international studying.
02

MBBS in China

  • Course Duration: The MBBS duration in China is 6 years including internship.
  • Entrance Test: No separate entrance test. A valid NEET score is required as per NMC guidelines.
  • Fees Structure: The total fee in Chinese universities ranges from ₹15 lakh to ₹35 lakh for the entire program.
  • Degree: Students in China are awarded the MD equivalent degree for MBBS.
  • Exposure: Students gain international exposure and improved global opportunities.
